# Humm — Mobile Web App

> Therapeutic Humming & Vagal Breathwork Guide

Humm is a minimalist, mobile-first web application designed to pair the physiological and neurological benefits of therapeutic humming (vagal nerve stimulation, sinus nitric oxide release, parasympathetic activation) with gentle, reference-guided pitch sequences.

## Primary Documentation
- [README.md](file:///Users/vv2024/Documents/Repos%20-%20vv2024/Humm/README.md): Project overview, features, tech stack, and development instructions.
- [PROJECT_STATE.md](file:///Users/vv2024/Documents/Repos%20-%20vv2024/Humm/PROJECT_STATE.md): Comprehensive system architecture, module capabilities, active tech stack, and development evolution.
